control_force_admission.rule: the SAME state continues WITHOUT the cap for 2 x cap steps

fresh_trail_control.reading: a fresh guard-free trail hits DPs over the same horizon, so the trapped trail zero-hit row is a cycle property, not a width property

no_tail_used: the cap is hard, so P(a trail runs past it) = 0 by construction: the waste row is cap x rate x price with no geometric tail
